symptom: PC1 received an IP address but cannot reach the file server FS1 on another VLAN. Ping to its own default gateway succeeds.
show_output:
R1# show ip route
Gateway of last resort is not set
C 192.168.10.0/24 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/0.10
C 192.168.20.0/24 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/0.20

PC1> ping 192.168.30.10
Reply from 192.168.10.1: Destination host unreachable.
actual_root_cause: No sub-interface or route exists for VLAN 30 on R1, so inter-VLAN routing to 192.168.30.0/24 is missing.

symptom: A new employee's PC shows limited connectivity and an address starting 169.254.
show_output:
PC7> ipconfig
IPv4 Address. . . : 169.254.11.98
Subnet Mask . . . : 255.255.0.0
Default Gateway . : 

SW1# show vlan brief
20   STAFF    active    Fa0/3, Fa0/4
actual_root_cause: The DHCP relay (ip helper-address) is missing on the VLAN 20 sub-interface, so no DHCP offer reached the host.

symptom: Users report the intranet portal is down, but it works when they type the IP address directly.
show_output:
PC3> ping 10.1.5.20
Reply from 10.1.5.20: bytes=32 time=1ms TTL=127
0% loss

PC3> nslookup portal.corp.local
Server: 10.1.9.9
*** portal.corp.local: Non-existent domain
actual_root_cause: The DNS server address handed out by DHCP points at a decommissioned server, so name lookups fail while IP connectivity is fine.

symptom: Two desks in accounts intermittently lose network access; both work fine when the other is unplugged.
show_output:
SW2# show ip arp
Internet 172.16.4.50  0  00E0.1234.AAAA ARPA
Internet 172.16.4.50  0  00E0.5678.BBBB ARPA
actual_root_cause: Two hosts were statically configured with the same IP address 172.16.4.50.

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi users can reach the internal HR file share, which should not be possible.
show_output:
R1# show access-lists
Extended IP access list GUEST-OUT
    10 permit ip any any
actual_root_cause: The guest ACL permits all traffic instead of denying access to internal subnets before the permit line.

symptom: A branch office PC can reach other machines in the branch but nothing at head office.
show_output:
RB# show ip route
Gateway of last resort is not set
C 192.168.50.0/24 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/1
actual_root_cause: The branch router has no default route or WAN route toward head office.

symptom: A newly cabled desk gets no link light and no IP address at all.
show_output:
SW1# show ip interface brief
FastEthernet0/9  unassigned  YES unset  administratively down  down
actual_root_cause: The switch port was left administratively shut down after maintenance.

symptom: A vendor cannot reach the newly published web server from outside the office.
show_output:
R1# show ip nat translations
(no entries)
R1# show run | include ip nat
 ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/2 overload
actual_root_cause: No static NAT entry exists mapping the public address to the internal web server address.

symptom: After a desk move a PC gets an IP in the wrong range and cannot reach its department server.
show_output:
SW1# show vlan brief
10   SALES     active   Fa0/6, Fa0/7
30   FINANCE   active   Fa0/12
actual_root_cause: The relocated port was left in VLAN 10 instead of being moved to VLAN 30.

symptom: A laptop brought back from home cannot reach anything on the office network.
show_output:
LT4> ipconfig
IPv4 Address. . . : 192.168.10.44
Subnet Mask . . . : 255.255.255.0
Default Gateway . : 192.168.1.1

LT4> ping 192.168.10.1
Request timed out.
actual_root_cause: The laptop still carries the home default gateway 192.168.1.1, which is outside its office subnet.

symptom: Half of a relocated team got IP addresses, the other half did not.
show_output:
R1# show ip dhcp pool
Pool VLAN60 :
 Total addresses : 30
 Leased addresses : 30
 Available addresses : 0
actual_root_cause: The DHCP scope for VLAN 60 was exhausted; every address in the pool was already leased.

symptom: Devices on VLAN 20 can ping each other but cannot reach any other VLAN.
show_output:
SW1# show interfaces trunk
Port  Vlans allowed on trunk
Gi0/1 1,10,30,40
actual_root_cause: VLAN 20 is not in the allowed VLAN list on the uplink trunk to the router.

symptom: A workstation cannot reach anything outside its own subnet after a manual IP change.
show_output:
PC34> ipconfig
IPv4 Address. . . : 10.5.2.30
Subnet Mask . . . : 255.255.0.255
actual_root_cause: The subnet mask 255.255.0.255 is not a valid contiguous mask.

symptom: Printing to the network printer fails from one department only.
show_output:
R1# show access-lists
Extended IP access list DEPT-B
    10 deny tcp 10.3.4.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.3.9.50 eq 9100
    20 permit ip any any
actual_root_cause: An ACL explicitly denies the printing port 9100 from the 10.3.4.0/24 department subnet.

symptom: A server was re-addressed and now nobody can reach it by name.
show_output:
PC40> ping 10.8.1.25
Reply from 10.8.1.25: bytes=32 time=2ms TTL=128
0% loss
PC40> nslookup app1.corp.local
*** Can't find app1.corp.local: Non-existent domain
actual_root_cause: The DNS A record for app1 still points at the old address and was never updated.

symptom: Internet browsing fails for all users while internal resources work normally.
show_output:
R1# show ip route
Gateway of last resort is not set
C 172.20.1.0/24 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/0
C 172.20.2.0/24 is directly connected, GigabitEthernet0/1
actual_root_cause: The default route toward the ISP was removed, leaving no gateway of last resort.

symptom: Two hosts that should be in the same VLAN are on different subnets and cannot see each other.
show_output:
SW3# show vlan brief
70   OPS   active   Fa0/2, Fa0/8
actual_root_cause: One host was given an address from a different subnet than the rest of VLAN 70.

symptom: VoIP handsets never come online after a switch replacement.
show_output:
SW4# show run interface Fa0/5
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
actual_root_cause: The voice VLAN was not configured on the access ports after the switch swap.

symptom: One PC can browse the web but cannot reach the internal ERP server.
show_output:
R1# show access-lists
Extended IP access list ERP-PROT
    10 permit tcp 10.6.5.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.6.8.40 eq 1521
    20 deny ip any host 10.6.8.40
actual_root_cause: The ERP ACL only permits the 10.6.5.0/24 subnet; the user's subnet 10.6.3.0/24 is denied.

symptom: Outbound internet works but a remote support tool cannot connect back in.
show_output:
R1# show ip nat translations
Pro Inside global      Inside local
udp 203.0.113.5:5060  192.168.90.31:5060
actual_root_cause: The static NAT entry maps the public address to 192.168.90.31 instead of the support host 192.168.90.30.

symptom: Wireless clients get addresses but wired clients on the same switch do not.
show_output:
R1# show run interface Gi0/0.10
 encapsulation dot1Q 10
 ip address 10.9.10.1 255.255.255.0
(no ip helper-address configured)
actual_root_cause: The ip helper-address is missing on the wired VLAN 10 sub-interface, so DHCP requests are not relayed.

symptom: A link between two switches came up but no traffic passes between buildings.
show_output:
SW5# show interfaces trunk
Port  Mode   Native vlan
Gi0/2 on     1
SW6# show interfaces trunk
Port  Mode   Native vlan
Gi0/2 on     99
actual_root_cause: The native VLAN does not match on the two ends of the trunk.

symptom: Users report the network is slow and one uplink shows constant errors.
show_output:
SW7# show interfaces Gi0/1
GigabitEthernet0/1 is up, line protocol is up
  1423 input errors, 1102 CRC, 0 frame
actual_root_cause: A failing cable or transceiver on the uplink is producing CRC errors.

symptom: A test machine cannot reach the internet, though its neighbour on the same desk can.
show_output:
PC66> ipconfig
IPv4 Address. . . : 10.7.1.80
Subnet Mask . . . : 255.255.255.0
Default Gateway . : 10.7.2.1
actual_root_cause: The default gateway 10.7.2.1 is outside the host's own 10.7.1.0/24 subnet.

symptom: After a firewall change, file transfers to the backup server hang partway through.
show_output:
R1# show access-lists
Extended IP access list BACKUP
    10 permit tcp any host 10.11.2.30 eq 22
    20 deny ip any any
actual_root_cause: The ACL permits only SSH to the backup host; the backup transfer port is denied by the implicit-style deny at line 20.

symptom: New subnet was added but its hosts cannot reach any other subnet.
show_output:
R1# show ip route
C 10.12.1.0/24 is directly connected, Gi0/0.10
C 10.12.2.0/24 is directly connected, Gi0/0.20
(no entry for 10.12.6.0/24)
actual_root_cause: No sub-interface was created on the router for the new VLAN 60 subnet.

symptom: Some websites load and others do not, with no obvious pattern.
show_output:
PC72> nslookup example.com
DNS request timed out.
PC72> ping 10.13.9.9
Request timed out.
actual_root_cause: The primary DNS server is unreachable, so lookups only succeed when a cached or secondary entry answers.

symptom: A camera system on its own VLAN lost connectivity to the recorder after a config change.
show_output:
SW8# show ip interface brief
FastEthernet0/14  unassigned  YES unset  down  down
actual_root_cause: The switch port serving the camera VLAN uplink is down.

symptom: Two departments were merged and now several machines report address conflicts.
show_output:
SW9# show ip arp
Internet 10.15.1.100  0  00E0.AAAA.1111 ARPA
Internet 10.15.1.100  0  00E0.BBBB.2222 ARPA
actual_root_cause: Overlapping static address assignments from the two merged departments produced duplicate IPs.

symptom: An external partner can reach the web server but not the API server behind the same public address.
show_output:
R1# show ip nat translations
Pro Inside global       Inside local
tcp 203.0.113.9:80     192.168.80.50:80
(no entry for port 8443)
actual_root_cause: Only the web port is statically translated; no NAT entry exists for the API port to reach 192.168.80.60.
